historyExplorationReview.direction: Preserved owner-approved Tab Scout identity and black/mint Daddy-series controls
historyExplorationReview.evidence: Synthetic native AX and visual inspection covered five filter menus, active-filter count and clear action, row disclosure, exact evidence fields, retag sheet scope switching, and a saved local tag disappearing from the untagged result set
historyExplorationReview.critique: 37/40; compact filters remain readable at the supported native window and expanded evidence stays aligned with the visit content

target: BrowserDaddy identity, mascot, icon, native shell and landing artwork

contract.purpose: BrowserDaddy helps Mac users understand and revisit their browsing by combining a unified history archive with measured frontmost-app attention.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md and PROJECT_STATUS.md; native source verification
contract.canonicalPurpose: BrowserDaddy helps people understand their browsing history and attention locally across browsers.
contract.driftNote: Purpose contract reviewed in the canonical project dossier. The scoped-folder permission flow preserves the approved native design and makes the privacy boundary explicit without changing the product purpose.
contract.audience: Mac users reviewing their browsing history and attention
contract.job: Recognize BrowserDaddy distinctly while retaining the owner-approved Daddy family
contract.thesis: Browser-specific character and symbols, never the reused storage box
contract.system: Tab Scout implemented within existing black/mint SwiftUI and Editorial landing. Browser access uses the existing band, row and button vocabulary for per-browser Connect, Change and Disconnect actions. Small marks use a simple face/browser-tab icon; large illustration preserves aspect ratio and alpha. No new UI library or runtime dependency.
contract.signature: Tab-carrying scout, mint backpack and attention compass; own simplified browser-tab icon.
contract.risk: Generated mockups are illustrative, not release evidence. The scoped-folder flow was inspected in a synthetic sandbox probe; final release qualification still requires signed migration and launch verification.

projectCheck.command: XcodeBuildMCP swift_package_test: 26 passed; scoped-folder onboarding and disconnect inspected in a synthetic sandbox probe; ios-landings pnpm check: 21 tests and 11 product builds/checks passed

ownerFeedback.note: Owner said any if fine after three directions. Selected A — Tab Scout for family continuity and browser-specific meaning; preserve established dark UI and Editorial landing. The later scoped-folder permission work remains within that approved system.

tabsRouterPolishReview.ownerDirection: Keep the current Mac utility design and polish its components; reject dashboard-style replacements.
tabsRouterPolishReview.before: Installed BrowserDaddy 0.4.0-5 showed a repeated AppleScript parse error in Tabs, cryptic window/tab indices, and empty striped list rows. Clicking links could surface the app window.
tabsRouterPolishReview.after: Isolated unsigned fixture build visually inspected through native UI: open-tab rows, grouping, search, no-results state, and clear-search action. Search state kept its header aligned; plain list removed empty striped rows.
tabsRouterPolishReview.checks: swift test --filter TabInventoryTests: 1 passed; swift test --filter LinkRouterTests: 11 passed; Swift package app build passed.
tabsRouterPolishReview.limits: The installed app was left untouched. Real Automation permission and clicked-link background behavior require a signed app build for device verification.

backgroundRouterReview.direction: Keep the owner-approved Tab Scout native utility system and existing floating picker.
backgroundRouterReview.interaction: Clicked links route without a visible app window; copied links show the existing target menu and require selection.
backgroundRouterReview.privacy: Safari extension checks Private Browsing before reading any page URL or title; uncertain pages are excluded.
backgroundRouterReview.checks: 11 focused routing tests, 2 tab inventory tests, 44 total Swift tests, Release Swift build, Xcode 26.6 universal extension build, isolated native copy-and-cancel check.
backgroundRouterReview.limits: Default-handler cold launch and enabled Safari extension await signed release runtime verification.
